title: Lexicographically Smallest Palindrome
summary: Given a string s consisting of lowercase English letters, you can perform operations where any character in s can be replaced with another lowercase English letter.
statement: Given a string s consisting of lowercase English letters, you can perform operations where any character in s can be replaced with another lowercase English letter. Your goal is to transform s into a palindrome using the minimum number of operations. If there are multiple possible palindromes with the same minimum number of operations, choose the lexicographically smallest one. Return the resulting palindrome string.
constraints: Replace any character with another lowercase letter at cost one.
First minimize the number of replacements needed to make s a palindrome.
Among all minimum-edit palindromes, return the lexicographically smallest.
hints: Each mirrored pair can be handled independently.
Equal characters need no edit; unequal characters require exactly one edit in every palindrome.
For an unequal pair, replace the larger character with the smaller one.
This uses the forced minimum one edit per mismatch and makes the earliest differing position as small as possible, which gives the lexicographically least optimum.
